claim_text: Our operations use minimal freshwater, depending heavily on groundwater abstraction, most of which is hypersaline or brackish and requires onsite reverse osmosis prior to use.
metric_name: Freshwater withdrawn; Total water withdrawals from groundwater sources

Most of our water inputs (87.5%) are from the abstraction of hypersaline or brackish groundwater, with only 1.1% of our water inputs from freshwater sources.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The water snapshot directly supports the claim that freshwater use was minimal and groundwater dominated total withdrawals.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that operations use minimal freshwater and depend heavily on groundwater abstraction, mostly hypersaline/brackish requiring onsite reverse osmosis before use. The evidence substantiates the “minimal freshwater” and “depend heavily on groundwater abstraction, mostly hypersaline/brackish” elements by stating that only 1.1% of water inputs are from freshwater sources and that 87.5% are from hypersaline or brackish groundwater abstraction, with groundwater withdrawals shown as 1,106.9 ML and freshwater withdrawn as 14.5 ML. However, the evidence does not substantiate the material assertion that the hypersaline/brackish groundwater ‘requires onsite reverse osmosis prior to use’ (no mention of reverse osmosis or treatment requirement), so the full claim is not verified.
